pageSub: Keys let other systems read and write this workspace over the REST API. A key can never do more than the role you give it, and never more than you can do yourself.
emptyBody: Create a key for each system that talks to this workspace, so you can revoke one without touching the others.
deniedBody: Your role ({role}) does not include API key management. Ask an owner.
deniedSupport: API keys cannot be managed during a support session.
loadErrorBody: The key list could not be loaded. Nothing was changed.
demoTitle: Demo workspace: keys are not issued
demoBody: Demo workspaces have no database, so the API is switched off and no real key is created. The list below shows what a live workspace looks like.
demoNotSaved: Demo workspace: no key was created.
formNameHelp: What uses this key, for example Zapier lead intake.
formRoleHelp: The key acts as a user with this role. You can only pick a role at or below your own.
formScopesHelp: Scopes narrow the role. A scope never grants more than the role allows.
createdBody: This is the only time the full key is shown. We store a one-way hash, so we cannot show it again. Treat it like a password.
revokeBody: Requests using this key fail at once with 401. This cannot be undone; create a new key instead.
rotateBody: A new secret replaces the old one. The old secret stops working immediately, so update the system that uses it right after.
errorBody: Something went wrong on our side. Nothing was changed. Try again.
invalidBody: Some values are not valid. Check the highlighted fields.
limitReached: This workspace already has the maximum number of active keys. Revoke one first.
deny_role_exceeds_you: That role has more access than you do.
deny_scope_not_held: You cannot grant a scope you do not hold: {scopes}.
authz_denied: You do not have permission to manage API keys.
